text: {"final": {"summary": "P1: added can_pass(road_id, vehicle, network=None) to logistics/access.py — validates the vehicle against VEHICLE_WEIGHT (ValueError for unknown vehicles) and returns whether road_status is OPEN. P2: added passable_route(warehouse_id, site, network=None) to logistics/routes.py — filters routes_between results to routes where every road is passable by truck or by van, picks the shortest by (km, id), returns (route, 'truck') if a truck can use every road on it else (route, 'van'), or None; best_route left unchanged. P3: added rerouted_sites(network=None) — enumerates unique (from, to) pairs from network['routes'], counts a site as rerouted only when passable_route finds a usable route whose id differs from best_route's pick, returns sorted site names. P4: added notify_rerouted(sites, day) to notifications/sms.py — loads active households, filters to those with site in sites and sms_ok True, queues one DELIVERY_MOVED SMS per household with {site, day} params, returns the messages. P5: in distribution/planner.py build_plan, replaced best_route with passable_route (setting route_id/vehicle from the (route, vehicle) tuple, 'unreachable' on None) and after building the plan calls notify_rerouted(rerouted_sites(network), day).", "done_steps": ["P1", "P2", "P3", "P4", "P5"]}}
